resources.string: Sign in through the cabinet and the vault will be on all your devices
There is no cloud vault yet. Create it in the app
It installs over the current version: passwords and sign-in are kept.
Sign in with your %1$s account, as in our other apps. The vault master password is separate: it stays on the device and is never sent to us, so the server cannot read any password.

The server keeps only the KeePass file (KDBX) encrypted with your master password and up to 20 previous versions. The master password cannot be recovered: write it down. The file opens in any KeePass app.
You are not signed in: the vault is only on this device
No cloud vault on this device yet
There are changes not sent to the server yet
Open the cabinet (or the bot) and confirm this code:
Signed in, but the vault server says: %1$s
Sign out? The vault stays on the device and on the server, syncing stops.
Sign in through the cabinet first
No previous versions on the server
Restore v%1$d? The open vault will close and this version becomes the newest on all devices (the current one stays in the history).

Versions usually merge by themselves. If that failed (for example, the master password was changed on another device), choose the main one. The other is kept: the device file as a copy, the server file in the history.
This password appeared in leaks %1$d times. Change it on the site and here.
This password was not found in known leaks.
The password is not revealed: only the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 hash leave the device (k-anonymity, Have I Been Pwned).
Allow this app to install updates and we will continue
Master password: at least 8 characters, better 4–5 random words. It stays on the device and nobody can recover it, so write it down.
The password of this file stays on the device. If you forget it, nobody can open the file. Use at least 8 characters or 4–5 random words.
The vault file is incomplete and was not sent; the server keeps the previous version
You signed in to another account. Close the vault and press “Cloud vault” on the first screen
The new server version did not open (was the master password changed on another device?). Close the vault and open it with the new password
Could not merge the server version (was the master password changed on another device?). Choose which one to keep in “Version conflict”
There is no vault on the server
Permission to install was not granted. Try again or use a link
Not enough space on the phone
None of the addresses worked. What was downloaded is kept and will be continued.
Installation was cancelled. Press “Update” again, the file is already downloaded
The phone cannot install over: the installed app is signed with another key
This build does not fit this phone
The phone blocked the installation. Download by link and install by hand
The update was not installed. Press “Update” again
